tag.vi: 🦶 Làm móng chân: chân mỏi, mùa dép sandal

occasion: You came for a pedicure, not a manicure: your feet are tired and sandal season is here.
constraints: You want a relaxing pedicure on both feet and a bright colour on your toes. You may ask about a foot scrub or massage and what it costs. You are happy when the stylist explains the steps and checks the water temperature.
openingLine: Hi! Can I get a pedicure today? My feet are so tired, and I want a bright colour for my sandals.
